protocol: self-timed compute region only (bench/harness.js); process startup is NOT included
measured: 2026-08-27, idle box, bench/tools/interleave.py, 51 rounds interleaved, warmup discarded, medians
description: Reference node medians for the compute region each fixture times itself around. Out-of-band and manual: the automated runner never invokes node (CLAUDE.md). Compare these only against bronze numbers taken the same way — a whole-process number is not comparable to one of these, because node's process floor on this box is ~31 ms and a bronze exe's is ~5.9 ms.
caveat: V8 is a speculative JIT. On a long monomorphic loop it will hoist, unroll and specialize, so the rows with sub-nanosecond ns_per_iter (proto_dispatch at 0.55, property_access at 1.06) are as much a measurement of what V8 proved loop-invariant as of what a property read costs. Read those as an upper bound on the gap, not as a dispatch-cost comparison.
